summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Profile Management & Privacy Features including social media links, privacy toggles, address management, and public profile filtering
passed_tests: Social media links (instagram, twitter, facebook, youtube, soundcloud, spotify) save correctly via API
Privacy toggle for 'show_email' - when false, email hidden from public profile; when true, email visible
Privacy toggle for 'show_phone' - when false, phone hidden from public profile; when true, phone visible
Privacy toggle for 'show_address' - when false, address hidden from public profile; when true, address visible
Privacy toggle for 'show_social' - when false, social media hidden from public profile; when true, social media visible
Shipping address updates correctly via PUT /api/users/profile with structured address object
Profile page displays formatted address when show_address is true
Public profile API correctly filters private data based on privacy settings
Own profile API shows all data regardless of privacy settings (authenticated user sees own data)
Backend privacy filtering logic working correctly in get_user_profile endpoint
All social media platforms (6 total) supported and saved correctly
Address structure matches registration format (country, state, city, street, postal_code)
Privacy settings persist correctly across profile updates
Frontend login API integration working correctly
Backend authentication and authorization working properly
